records.feedback: A middle position need not cancel: the two sides have different numbers of optional positions. One earlier position gives 2¹=2 maximum roles; two later positions give 2²=4 minimum roles. Thus 2×(2−4)=−4. The other 2 remains a separate position. Rightmost-maximum and leftmost-minimum ownership resolves the tie.
中间不保证抵消：左右可选位置数不同。 左侧 1 个位置，最大值角色 2¹=2 种；右侧 2 个位置，最小值角色 2²=4 种。所以 2×(2−4)=−4。相邻另一个 2 仍是独立位置；用最右最大值、最左最小值的负责人规则处理相等值。
